Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square dialogue-speaker portrait preview for Bagyong Bahay, a Filipino typhoon-preparation game with a modest PSX-style 3D world. Redesign the supplied player portrait into an original coherent art direction for approval. Produce ONE portrait, not a sheet.
Input images: Image 1 is the character identity and framing reference (playerTalking2.png); Image 2 is the current game's screenshot, used ONLY for world palette and mood, not character identity; Image 3 is the game's illustrated ticket used ONLY for its broad angular graphic shapes, restrained print texture, teal and charcoal. Do not reproduce ticket decorations, text or UI.
Subject: same Filipino adolescent boy, medium warm brown skin, thick tousled black side-parted hair with distinct pointed locks, rounded prominent ears, white/off-white crew-neck shirt with a dark charcoal collar. Friendly small closed-mouth smile, calm attentive brows, direct gaze. Retain recognizable identity, skin tone, hair silhouette and clothing from Image 1.
Style/medium: original crisp 2D illustrated portrait using broad polygonal cel-shaded color planes, dark controlled contours, angular hair masses, simple expressive dark eyes with tiny restrained highlights, only 2–4 values per material. Stylized and approachable but grounded, slightly uncanny storm-game atmosphere. A few sparse dither/print flecks, never crayon scribbles. Low-poly visual language translated into readable illustrated faces, rather than a literal 3D render. Clean silhouette, no glossy anime rendering, no tiny triangles all over face.
Scene/backdrop: simplified desaturated olive/sea-green Filipino home wall and a vague dark window rectangle with muted storm-grey light. Background must be very quiet and lower contrast than face, built from 3–5 large shapes. This is a character background, not a detailed landscape.
Composition: square 1024x1024 full-bleed finished portrait asset. Frontal head-and-upper-shoulders crop like Image 1, centered, top of hair comfortably inset, face occupies about 65 percent of height. Consistent clean rectangular thin charcoal-and-desaturated-sea-green frame with one fine ivory inset rule, equal on all four sides. No rough handwritten white frame.
Lighting/palette: diffuse overcast upper-left light; warm natural brown face clearly visible against muted charcoal/olive background. Ivory shirt, black teal hair shadows. Restrained soft amber warmth only in skin. Keep contrast readable when scaled to 150x150 pixels.
Constraints: opaque background; no text, captions, logos, UI controls, watermark, scanlines, chromatic aberration, photorealistic skin, shiny 3D plastic, hyper-detailed linework, decorative stars, heavy grain, giant featureless black button eyes, horror injuries or new accessories. Keep emotional warmth and clarity.
